name: Agention
description: Questions your agents ask you, from your own Agention server

settings.label: Server address
settings.hint: Your Agention server's origin, as you open it in a browser.

settings.label: Local server listens on
settings.hint: Where the server Pitwall keeps running listens: an address on this computer and a port (point tailscale serve at it). If a server you started yourself already listens here, Pitwall uses it and starts nothing.

settings.label: API key
settings.hint: Create one in Agention's Settings → API keys with the scopes threads:write and sessions:read, copy it, then paste it here.

net.reason: To read your agents' threads from your Agention server and send your answers

permissions.agents.read: To show which of your agents asks, and badge the ones waiting on you
permissions.shortcut: To open your Agention inbox from anywhere in Pitwall

actions.label: Set up Agention in my agents
actions.description: Installs Agention's plugin, pinned to v0.7.0, in Claude Code and Codex (whichever you have).

actions.label: Install Agention's server here
actions.description: Installs (or updates) Agention's server, v0.7.0, on this computer with npm. Pitwall then keeps it running while the extension is on.

actions.label: Remove Agention from my agents
actions.description: Removes Agention's plugin marketplace, and with it the plugin, from Claude Code and Codex.

firstRun.label: Sign in for the first time
firstRun.again: A new link replaces your passkeys and signs your browsers out once it is used; a link not used yet stops working.
